description: Search the products whose prices TagDip tracks in Polish online stores (electronics, PC parts, home appliances, perfume, LEGO and more). Returns matching models (all versions of one model together) and products with their lowest current price in PLN and the number of stores. Use it first to find a product_id for the other tools. Queries work best as brand + model, e.g. "rtx 5070", "iphone 17 256", "dyson v15".

max_price_pln.description: Only products sold for at most this many złoty.

query.description: Product name, model or code (EAN or part number).

name: search_products
title: Search products
